newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks weather storm, at least until Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks weather storm, at least until Tuesday.

text.p: Investors ignored Monday's severe cyclonic storm in coastal areas and maintained buying, spurring Dhaka stocks to close nearly four percent higher, but brokers feared a nervous reaction on Tuesday.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) rose 47.50 points or 3.99 percent at 1,236.96 on a tunrover of 96.7 million taka. Gainers led the losers by 113 to 27.

Brokers said any major damage in the industrial belt in Chittagong would unnerve the market. Washing out of shrimp beds would affect the food scrips, they added. Quasem Drycells rose 6.74 taka to 86.09 and Amam Sea Food rose 253 to 3,509.
